newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani money market rates remain high.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani money market rates remain high.

text.p: Pakistani money market rates remained high in the week ended on Thursday and dealers said the rates were likely to open high on Sunday.
"Once again the week ended with overnight rates at the same level of 17 percent," a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
The market was quiet for much of the day, but some overnight deals were done in the last hour of trading, he said.
Rates stayed firm despite an inflow of 900 million rupees from an open market operation maturity, the dealer said.
